annotations.title: Live Web URL to Clean LLM Markdown Extractor

description: Fetch any live web URL and convert its main content into clean, boilerplate-free Markdown optimized for RAG pipelines and autonomous agents. Use this tool when ingesting competitor pages, documentation, or articles without HTML noise, navigation chrome, or script tags. Returns structured Markdown preserving heading hierarchy and tables, extracted internal and external links, word and token counts, and a SHA-256 content digest.

include_links.description: When true, extracts a structured list of outbound and internal anchor links from the page (default: true).

include_metadata.description: When true, includes page title, word count, estimated LLM token count, and SHA-256 content digest (default: true).

max_characters.description: Maximum character length of the returned Markdown document between 500 and 100000 (default: 16000).

url.description: Full HTTP or HTTPS web page URL to fetch and convert into clean Markdown.

name: markdown_clean_extract
title: Live Web URL to Clean LLM Markdown Extractor
